pairs: I cried out to the Lord with my voice,
In die tribulationis meæ Deum exquisivi;
In the days of my tribulation, I sought God,
with my hands opposite him in the night,
My soul refused to be consoled.
I considered the days of antiquity,
et annos æternos in mente habui.
and I held the years of eternity in my mind.
Et meditatus sum nocte cum corde meo,
And I meditated in the night with my heart,
So then, will God reject for eternity?
aut non apponet ut complacitior sit adhuc?
Will he not continue to allow himself to show favor?
aut in finem misericordiam suam abscindet,
Or, will he cut off his mercy in the end,
And would God ever forget to be merciful? Or,
aut continebit in ira sua misericordias suas?
would he, in his wrath, restrict his mercies?
This change is from the right hand of the Most High.”
I was mindful of the works of the Lord.
quia memor ero ab initio mirabilium tuorum:
For I will be mindful from the beginning of your wonders,
et meditabor in omnibus operibus tuis,
and I will meditate on all your works.
And I will take part in your intentions.
O God, is in what is holy.
quis deus magnus sicut Deus noster?
Which God is great like our God?
Tu es Deus qui facis mirabilia:
You are the God who performs miracles.
notam fecisti in populis virtutem tuam.
You have made your virtue known among the peoples.
Redemisti in brachio tuo populum tuum,
the sons of Jacob and of Joseph.
and the depths were stirred up.
Great was the sound of the waters.
For your arrows also pass by.
The voice of your thunder is like a wheel.
Your flashes have illuminated the whole world.
Your way is through the sea,
et semitæ tuæ in aquis multis,
and your paths are through many waters.
And your traces will not be known.
You have conducted your people like sheep,
by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
